gloss_en: the rectification of the coinage (tikkun ha-matbe'a) — Jacob's establishing/rectifying of coinage for the city (per the Talmudic reading of "vayichan penei ha-ir", Gen. 33:18), signifying in Likutey Moharan 23 the spiritual repair of money and the breaking of the craving for wealth through the shining light of the face
